svg.text: Ludi track mapping — 68 track squares (17 per arm) + 7-square home columns
19×19 grid, (row, col) 0-indexed from top-left. Derived from design-pack lib.js cellType / STARTS / ENTRIES. DRAFT — awaiting Dean's approval.
Starts (17 apart): red 0 · green 17 · yellow 34 · blue 51
Home entry = start − 2: red 66 · green 15 · yellow 32 · blue 49
Safe cells = the 4 start stars only: 0, 17, 34, 51
Journey start → home = 66 track + 7 home column + 1 centre = 74 steps
home entry: track 66 at (18,9), turns up
home entry: track 15 at (9,18), turns left
home entry: track 32 at (0,9), turns down
home entry: track 49 at (9,0), turns right
• Numbers 0–67 = absolute engine track index (zone "track", cell).
• Pink ticks show movement direction: counter-clockwise as drawn.
• Corner steps around the centre are diagonal: 6→7, 23→24, 40→41, 57→58.
• Coloured cell + star = come-out (start). Coloured outline = home entry.
• A piece never stands on start − 1 (e.g. red skips 67): it turns
into its home column from the entry arrow cell.
